name: app-dwi-hm-vm-snr
desc: Computes DWI signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) within Horizontal Meridian (HM) and Vertical Meridian (UVM/LVM) cortical ROIs, per subject. ROI masks are built from pRF retinotopy maps (polarAngle/eccentricity/varea), then SNR is computed with scilpy's compute_snr (mean b0 signal in the ROI / std of an auto-estimated background-noise mask). Used as a confound check for tractography-based HM-vs-VM connectivity comparisons.

varea_labels.desc: Comma-separated varea label(s) to restrict the ROI to (e.g. '1' for V1 only). Empty = all Benson14 visual areas (varea>0).

b0_thr.desc: b-value threshold below which a volume is treated as a b0.

outputs.desc: Per-subject mean DWI SNR (b0) in HM/UVM/LVM cortical ROIs, one row per meridian, with voxel counts.
